name: smart-mobility-mvp
description: Smart Pause & Resume Vehicle Sharing Platform MVP for EIC Accelerator

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run backend:dev" "npm run dashboard:dev" "npm run simulator:dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend/operator-dashboard && npm install && cd ../mobile-app && npm install && cd ../../vehicle-simulator && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:mobile
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.eic:demo: npm run simulator:dev & npm run dashboard:dev & npm run mobile:dev

author: Smart Mobility Team
